name: @gemini-markets/sdk
description: Gemini exchange TypeScript SDK — browser and server entry points with HMAC, OAuth (PKCE), REST, and WebSocket support.

scripts.smoke:sandbox: npm run build && GEMINI_SMOKE_ENV=sandbox node --env-file=.env.sandbox scripts/smoke-sandbox.mjs --market-type=market-data
scripts.smoke:sandbox:market-data: npm run build && GEMINI_SMOKE_ENV=sandbox node --env-file=.env.sandbox scripts/smoke-sandbox.mjs --market-type=market-data
scripts.smoke:sandbox:prediction-markets: npm run build && GEMINI_SMOKE_ENV=sandbox node --env-file=.env.sandbox scripts/smoke-sandbox.mjs --market-type=prediction-markets
scripts.smoke:sandbox:oauth: npm run build && GEMINI_OAUTH_ENV=sandbox node --env-file=.env.sandbox scripts/smoke-oauth.mjs
scripts.smoke:oauth: npm run build && GEMINI_OAUTH_ENV=sandbox node --env-file=.env.sandbox scripts/smoke-oauth.mjs
scripts.verify:sandbox:rest: npm run build && GEMINI_SMOKE_ENV=sandbox node --env-file=.env.sandbox scripts/verify-sandbox-rest.mjs
scripts.verify:sandbox:market-data: npm run build && GEMINI_MD_ENV=sandbox node --env-file=.env.sandbox scripts/verify-market-data-live.mjs
scripts.smoke:prod:market-data: npm run build && GEMINI_SMOKE_ENV=production node --env-file=.env scripts/smoke-sandbox.mjs --market-type=market-data
scripts.smoke:prod:prediction-markets: npm run build && GEMINI_SMOKE_ENV=production node --env-file=.env scripts/smoke-sandbox.mjs --market-type=prediction-markets
scripts.smoke:prod:oauth: npm run build && GEMINI_OAUTH_ENV=production node --env-file=.env scripts/smoke-oauth.mjs
scripts.verify:prod:rest: npm run build && GEMINI_SMOKE_ENV=production node --env-file=.env scripts/verify-sandbox-rest.mjs
scripts.verify:prod:market-data: npm run build && GEMINI_MD_ENV=production node --env-file=.env scripts/verify-market-data-live.mjs
scripts.verify:package: npm run build && node scripts/verify-browser-imports.mjs && node scripts/verify-browser-bundle.mjs && node scripts/verify-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-api-surface.mjs
scripts.regenerate: node scripts/generate-prediction-markets.mjs && node scripts/generate-rest-modules.mjs && node scripts/generate-rest-ownership.mjs && npm run regenerate:websocket-types
